question: How many customers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers

question: What's my total revenue?
sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered')

question: Revenue by month
sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Revenue this month
sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE date_trunc('month', order_date) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered')

question: Top 5 customers by total spend
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find repeat customers
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 1 ORDER BY order_count DESC

question: Best customers
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 10

question: Top 10 products by revenue
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS product_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY product_revenue DESC LIMIT 10

question: Number of orders by status
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC

question: Products by category
sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY product_count DESC

question: Customers by state
sql: SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY state ORDER BY customer_count DESC

question: Average order value
sql: SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS avg_order_value FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered')
